answer: Make entry depend on an unaffiliated underwriter. To join, a new agent needs a stranger from outside its own graph to lock a bond in a shared vault. That underwriter is its only jetty onto the honest economy, and the bond is slashed if the newcomer defrauds anyone. Minting a thousand sybils then means finding a thousand independent outsiders, each willing to risk a hard-earned relic of standing: capital that cannot be pooled or faked.
